title: Üşüme

characters.BOY: a little boy of about seven with short brown hair
characters.MOTHER: his mother, a woman in her thirties with a dark brown bun and a cream cardigan
characters.MAN: a young man of about twenty-five with short brown hair, wearing a navy coat
characters.OLDMOM: an older woman in her sixties with grey hair in a bun and a cream cardigan

scenes.prompt: At the front door of a cozy house on a snowy morning, {MOTHER} kneels and wraps a red scarf around the neck of {BOY}, who frowns impatiently with a school bag.
At a train station, {MAN} carries a suitcase and boards a train, looking back over his shoulder, steam and soft morning light.

scenes.text: Bir akşam soğukta yürürken kimse sana "Üşüme" demedi.
scenes.prompt: On a cold snowy night in a big city street, {MAN} walks alone with his collar up, hands in pockets, snowflakes falling, city lights.
{MAN} stops on a snowy street under a street lamp, looking at a photo on his phone, a soft warm memory glow around him.
At the open door of a warmly lit house in the snow, {MAN} hugs {OLDMOM} tightly, she smiles with closed eyes, warm golden light from inside.

caption:
Bazı sözler başka kelimelerle söylenir. Annen sana en çok ne derdi? 🤍

Bugün onu ara.
